hints.title: Center Outward Expansion
hints.text: A palindrome mirrors around its center. A string with length n has 2n minus 1 potential centers corresponding to each character and each adjacent inter-character gap.

hints.title: Dual-Pointer Symmetry Check
hints.text: From each candidate center, expand left and right as long as characters match and boundary constraints hold, tracking the longest valid window.

hints.title: Window Maximization Procedure
hints.text: Iterate index i from zero to n minus one. Call a helper expanding from i, i for odd lengths and i, i plus one for even lengths. Update max start and max length whenever a longer palindrome is found.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N^2) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all substrings takes O(N^2) and validating each takes O(N), resulting in O(N^3) time which exceeds limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Center expansion requires O(1) auxiliary space whereas 2D DP matrix requires O(N^2) memory for the same time bound.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize both odd and even parity centers and implement clean expansion logic without out-of-bounds errors.
